assumptions.statement: The site and all three key-area polygons are repository-maintained rough provisional geometry, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All derived geometry, area, ratio, figures, HTML and PDFs are suitable only for intake discussion and must be regenerated from official polygons before precision-sensitive professional use.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, green ratio controls, setbacks, parcel controls and approved land uses are absent.
assumptions.impact: The proposal expresses a reference design method and marks statutory/intensity metrics unknown; it does not claim an approved regulatory plan.

assumptions.statement: Cleared existing-building footprints, age, use, condition, ownership and parcel data are absent.
assumptions.impact: Building polygons are schematic adaptable interface blocks only; no parcel-level retain, renovate or demolish decision is made.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, sections, station boundaries, flows, parking supply and safety constraints are absent.
assumptions.impact: Road features express connectivity objectives only; exact alignments, crossings, station integration and engineering feasibility require professional study.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection extents, construction-control zones, park implementation boundaries and verified historic asset inventory are absent.
assumptions.impact: Cultural routes and landmarks remain reversible conceptual directions and cannot override heritage, green-line or blue-line controls.

assumptions.statement: Utilities, drainage, flood, fire, energy, data infrastructure and municipal capacity data are absent.
assumptions.impact: Infrastructure proposals are service principles rather than engineering designs or capacity conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Seven international cases are first-party public mechanism references, not causal benchmarks or copy-ready policies.
assumptions.impact: Only governance and spatial-interface mechanisms are transferred; foreign performance numbers, legal systems and land policies are not projected onto Haidian.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenarios require opt-in participation, data minimization, accountable operators, human review, incident reporting and a defined exit/restoration route.
assumptions.impact: Scenario nodes are test briefs rather than approved deployments, procurement decisions or vendor commitments.

assumptions.statement: The three phases are evidence and readiness gates, not a construction schedule, investment plan or approved government programme.
assumptions.impact: Progression requires official data, independent evaluation and separate human-led statutory, engineering and procurement decisions.
